glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

instructions: Translate every "en" string into Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), game-guide register. Follow glossary.json strictly. Keep ⟦0⟧-style placeholders, numbers, units and wiki markup exactly. Return only {"items":[{"k":"...","zh":"..."}]} with the same k values.

units.en: ⟦0⟧ The party to set. elections_allowed = <bool> Whether elections are allowed. Optional. last_election = <date> When the last election was. Optional. election_frequency = <int> How often in months an election occurs. Optional. long_name = <string> The long name of the country's new ruling party, appearing when hovering over it. Optional. name = <string> The name of the country's new ruling party. Optional.
set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no last_election = "1935.12.17" election_frequency = 48 long_name = TAG_party_long name = TAG_party }
Sets the political status of the country, including the ruling party and elections.
Before 1.7, included ⟦0⟧ for assigning party popularities, which has been moved to ⟦1⟧
Sets the political party popularities for the current scope.
The popularities must add up to 100, otherwise the command will have no effect.
⟦0⟧ The party to change. If using a tag, uses that tag's ruling party. popularity = <int> / <variable> The amount of popularity to change.
Adjusts the popularity for the specified party in the current scope.
Values used are 0 to 1. You can use ideology = ROOT to increase the popularity of the currently ruling party.
⟦0⟧ The party to change. popularity = <int> The amount of popularity to set.
Sets the popularity for the specified political party in the current scope.
⟦0⟧ The party to change. long_name = <string> The new full name for the party. name = <string> The new short name for the party.
set_party_name = { ideology = neutrality long_name = GER_neutrality_party_kaiserreich_long name = GER_neutrality_party_kaiserreich }
Changes the name of the specified political party for the current scope.
The name appears in the country politics/diplomacy view, the long name appears in the tooltip when hovering over the party.
⟦0⟧ The country to hold an election for.
Executes the events in the ⟦0⟧ on action for the current scope.
Balance of power is defined in ⟦0⟧ files.

⟦0⟧ Balance of power to set/modify. left_side = <BoP side ID> The left side of the BoP. right_side = <BoP side ID> The right side of the BoP. set_default = <bool> Resets the BoP to the initial state defined in the file. Optional, defaults to false. set_value = <decimal> The new value of the BoP. Optional, defaults to not changing the value.
set_power_balance = { id = my_bop left_side = my_bop_left_side right_side = my_bop_right_side }
Sets a new balance of power or edits the existing one.
Necessary for a balance of power to appear. For the default state, ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ directly inside of the BoP are read.
Removes the balance of power in entirety.
⟦0⟧ Balance of power to modify. value = <decimal> The value to add. tooltip_side = <BoP side ID> The side to show in the tooltip. Optional.
add_power_balance_value = { id = my_bop value = -0.1 tooltip_side = my_bop_side }
Pushes the balance of power towards one side.
⟦0⟧ Balance of power to modify. modifier = <static modifier> The static modifier to apply.
Applies a balance of power modifier.
Cancels a balance of power modifier.
Cancels all balance of power modifiers.
⟦0⟧ Balance of power to modify. side = <BoP side ID> The side whose GFX to change. gfx = <sprite> The sprite to change the GFX to.
set_power_balance_gfx = { id = my_bop side = my_bop_side gfx = GFX_my_bop_side_new }
Changes the appearance of one of the sides within the balance of power.
Makes the current scope a major country.
Releases the specified non-existent country as a free nation within the current country's owned states.

The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost. If looking to make a subject into an independent nation, use set_autonomy. States that are owned but not controlled will be transferred to the released country, but won't be controlled by it.
Releases the specified non-existent country as a free nation within the current country's controlled states.

The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost.
Releases the specified non-existent country as a puppet of the current scope within the current country's owned states.

The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost. States that are owned but not controlled will be transferred to the released country, but won't be controlled by it.
Releases the specified non-existent country as a puppet of the current scope within the current country's controlled states.
⟦0⟧ The subject country. autonomy_state = <type> The type of autonomy state to set. freedom_level = <float> The new freedom level value. Optional.
release_autonomy = { target = VIN autonomy_state = autonomy_puppet freedom_level = 0.5 }
Releases the specified non-existent country as a subject of the specified autonomy of the current scope within the current country's owned states.

The effect does nothing if the country exists. All states that are cored by the specified country will be given to it. If the current country has a core on a state transferred to the released country, the core will be lost. States that are owned but not controlled will be transferred to the released country, but won't be controlled by it. The autonomy states are found in ⟦0⟧.
The current scope guarantees the target country.
⟦0⟧ effect can be used to remove it.
The current scope grants military access to the target country.
⟦0⟧ The target country with an attache.
Recalls the current scope's attaché from the specified country.
⟦0⟧ The target country to alter the relationship with ROOT. relation = <type> The relation to change. active = <bool> Whether the relation is started or broken.
diplomatic_relation = { country = SOV relation = guarantee active = no }
Used to define a diplomatic relation between the current scope and target scope country.
Possible relations: non_aggression_pact guarantee puppet military_access docking_rights embargo air_base_access
⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The opinion modifier to add.

The current scope gains the specified opinion modifier ⟦0⟧. Can also be used to modify trade relations by adding 'trade = yes' in the opinion <modifier> in ⟦1⟧. If used with a trade opinion_modifier the behaviour is reversed, meaning that the target gains the trade opinion towards the ⟦2⟧.
⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The opinion modifier to remove.
The current scope loses the specified opinion modifier ⟦0⟧.
The target scope gains the specified opinion modifier ⟦0⟧.
Opinion modifiers are found in ⟦0⟧. Useful for when you don't know what the current scope will be.
⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The relation modifier to add.
The current scope gains the specified relation modifier ⟦0⟧.
Relation modifiers are found in ⟦0⟧ files, used to apply a ⟦1⟧ with a non-static target. To change the diplomatic opinion of a country, see ⟦2⟧.
⟦0⟧ The target country. modifier = <modifier> The relation modifier to remove.
The current scope loses the specified relation modifier for ⟦0⟧.
Relation modifiers are found in ⟦0⟧, used to apply a ⟦1⟧ with a non-static target. To change the diplomatic opinion of a country, see ⟦2⟧.
⟦0⟧ The target country. value = <0-1> How much collaboration to add.
Adds collaboration in TAG with the scoped country.
⟦0⟧ The target country. value = <0-1> How much collaboration will be set.
Sets the collaboration in TAG with the scoped country.
Recalls volunteers sent to the specified country back to the current country.
⟦0⟧ The new occupation law enacted by the previous scope or ⟦1⟧.

USA = { GER = { set_occupation_law = foreign_civilian_oversight } } # Changes USA's occupation law for GER. USA = { USA = { set_occupation_law = default_law } } # Changes the USA's default occupation law to the default.
Sets the occupation law of the country.

⟦0⟧ will be the country for whom the occupation law will be changed. If PREV is not a country, nothing changes. If PREV is the same country, changes the default occupation law. If PREV is different, default_law resets the country-specific law to the global default, otherwise it resets the default law to the occupation law with ⟦1⟧ in definition. Can also be used in state scope.

USA = { GER = { set_occupation_law_where_available = foreign_civilian_oversight } } # Changes USA's occupation law for GER where possible. USA = { USA = { set_occupation_law_where_available = default_law } } # Changes the USA's default occupation law to the default where possible.

Identical to ⟦0⟧, except if the law is impossible to set, tries again at every smaller sub-set: if default is impossible, tries every single individual occupied country; if the country's law is impossible to change, tries every single state within the country.
As of 1.14.7, this effect ignores country scoping and always applies to the ROOT, instead the ⟦0⟧ effect can be used to break the embargoes of other countries.
Opens market access between the two countries.
Creates a faction with the specified name for the current scope. The current scope and any subjects automatically join the faction.

⟦0⟧ Faction template id. OR template = <string> The template of the faction. name = <loc_key> The name of the faction. icon = <sprite> The icon of the faction. color = <int> The color of the faction in RGB format.

create_faction_from_template = faction_template_GER_mitteleuropa_alliance create_faction_from_template = { template = faction_template_defensive_democratic name = AUS_alpine_federation icon = GFX_faction_logo_generic_2 color = { 100 100 150 } }
Create a faction from a template allows for optional customization of name, icon and color.
⟦0⟧ The TAG of the nation to add to the faction of the current scope.
Adds the country to the faction of the current scope.
Dismantles the faction of the current scope.
Removes the current scope from the faction they are part of.
Removes the specified scope from the faction led by the current scope.
Sets a faction name as the loc name.
Sets the current country as the faction leader.
Sets the current country as the faction spymaster.
Set a rule on the country's faction.
Changes current country's faction manifest, the previous manifest is removed.
Adds a goal to the current’s country faction.
Remove a goal from the current’s country faction.
⟦0⟧ The category of the faction goal. value = <int> / <variable> A value of the faction goal slot.
Adds extra goal slots to the faction for a specific category.
